findings.fact: Evernorth selected Coinbase as the principal market for XRP for financial-reporting purposes.

evidence.excerpt: Based on this assessment, we selected Coinbase as the trading platform market that represents the principal market for XRP for financial reporting purposes.

selection_factors: consistency and stability of quoted prices across markets
findings.important_limitation: Evernorth says it does not actively trade XRP on digital-asset markets; Coinbase is its accounting principal-market selection, not proof of Evernorth execution flow or Coinbase purchases.

findings.fact: Evernorth states its XRP is held with third-party custodians, initially BitGo Trust.
findings.distinction: BNY's Ripple/RLUSD reserve and eligible-client custody relationships are separate. Do not attribute Evernorth's XRP custody to BNY.

findings.fact: Evernorth may direct Cantor to purchase up to 5,218,935 newly issued shares at 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to volume and ownership limits; the resale registration became effective October 30.

terms.purchase_price: 97% of applicable VWAP, with alternative pricing conditions for larger-volume requests
terms.facility_expiry: first day of month following the 14-month anniversary of 2026-10-23, unless earlier terminated

findings.capital_classification: FACILITY_CAPACITY_NOT_CASH_PROCEEDS; 500K FEE IS A CONTRACTUAL FINANCING COST OBLIGATION, NOT CAPITAL RAISED
findings.draw_status: No actual ELOC share purchase/proceeds were disclosed in this reviewed filing; do not assume a draw.
findings.fee_status: Filing says Evernorth agreed to pay the non-refundable fee; it does not explicitly confirm cash payment in the reviewed text.

findings.fact: Evernorth assumed 11,739,645 warrants at close; 3,073,366 were exercised for cash between October 12 and November 9, producing $35.3M gross; 8,666,279 remained.
findings.interpretation: At the disclosed November 12 Class A price, the $11.50 exercise strike was out of the money. The warrant quote may reflect time/option value; no future exercise is assumed.
findings.warning: This is a mathematical maximum conditional on all 8,666,279 remaining warrants being cash-exercised at $11.50; it is not committed capital or a forecast.

findings.fact: At October 9 closing, Evernorth reported $272.6M gross cash ($224.6M private placement plus $48.0M SPAC trust released after redemptions) and approximately 388.91M XRP contributed in kind.
anti_double_counting: The 388.91M XRP is in-kind contributed property, not cash.
The 84.366M XRP acquired with advance cash is a use of raised cash, not additional capital.
Warrant proceeds are separate cash receipts after closing.
The $0.5M ELOC fee is a cost, not an inflow.

findings.fact: Pubco identifies its principal asset as approximately 71.5% ownership of Pathfinder.
findings.interpretation: Do not attribute 100% of Pathfinder's XRP or other assets to public Pubco shareholders.
